subject: English
title: CISCE curriculum: English, Class IV

source.read: A third-party copy of the Class IV pages of the CISCE curriculum (English: printed pages 19 to 23), hosted by BYJU'S
source.note: UNOFFICIAL SOURCE. The pages do not name their publisher or year, and were read through a text summary of the PDF, not the PDF itself. The official document on cisce.org could not be reached from the build environment. CISCE is understood not to prescribe a textbook for this class, so a school's own book and term plan may order or extend these topics.

licence: Strand names as printed (facts). Every outcome is written by OpenPath in its own words with a pointer to its strand and line; no curriculum text is reproduced.
review: OpenPath curriculum inventory (research from a secondary source; not an educator review)

outcomes.text: Takes part in discussions with the teacher and classmates on many topics.
outcomes.note: Speaking is not practised in the app.

outcomes.text: Answers particular questions, and comments and adds to a topic.
outcomes.note: Speaking is not practised in the app.

outcomes.text: Reports on a topic or text in order, with facts and describing details.
outcomes.note: Speaking is not practised in the app.

outcomes.text: Tells a story or an experience in order, clearly and at a steady pace.
outcomes.note: Speaking is not practised in the app.

outcomes.text: Enjoys listening to poems, songs, riddles and tongue twisters.
outcomes.note: The app has no poems or songs to listen to.

outcomes.text: Picks out key situations, shares ideas and gives opinions.
outcomes.note: Speaking is not practised in the app.

outcomes.text: Takes dictation of a passage already seen.
outcomes.note: Listen and write dictates sentences one at a time, and they are unseen, not from a passage read before.

outcomes.text: Reads with understanding, finding details, the order of events and the main idea.
outcomes.note: Reading course: details, order of events and the main idea.

outcomes.text: Connects what is read to personal experience.
outcomes.note: The app does not ask for a personal response.

outcomes.text: Reads beyond the set text and enjoys reading.
outcomes.note: The app has short practice texts only; a longer book can be added through My Books.

outcomes.text: Works out unfamiliar words from the words around them.
outcomes.note: New words shows each word in a sentence; working a meaning out from context alone is not practised.

outcomes.text: Looks words up in a dictionary or thesaurus, on paper or on a computer.
outcomes.note: Outside the app.

outcomes.text: Writes at least two paragraphs, about 150 words, on a topic.
outcomes.note: Writing of this kind is being built separately.

outcomes.text: Writes a narrative with events, actions, thoughts and feelings.
outcomes.note: Writing of this kind is being built separately.

outcomes.text: Arranges sentences in a sensible order.
outcomes.note: Reading covers the order of events; arranging whole sentences into a paragraph is not practised.

outcomes.text: Uses linking words such as firstly, then, later and finally.
Writes about personal experiences or real situations.
outcomes.note: Writing of this kind is being built separately.

outcomes.text: Uses words and phrases suited to the class, including ones for feelings and actions.
outcomes.note: New words teaches level-appropriate words; it is not organised by feelings and actions.

outcomes.text: Writes a letter to a parent, friend or relative.
outcomes.note: Writing of this kind is being built separately.

outcomes.text: Recognises and explains common idioms, sayings and proverbs.
outcomes.note: A small set of proverbs is practised, each with its meaning; idioms are not yet.

outcomes.text: Makes subjects and verbs agree.
Uses capital letters correctly in titles.
Punctuates spoken words in dialogue.
Uses the apostrophe for one owner, and tells plurals from possessives.
Spells words suited to the class, checking a reference when needed.
outcomes.note: The Spelling Bee, and words misspelt in writing that return as My tricky words.
